factory.qcIntro: What we verify before an order leaves the factory floor.
factory.qc1b: Abrasive surface consistency against the confirmed grade.
factory.qc2b: Backing type, weight and dimensional tolerance of finished belts and discs.
factory.qc3b: Pack quantities, labels, carton marks and private-label artwork match the confirmed order.
factory.certNote: Certification marks shown are placeholders pending published certificates.
factory.ctaSub: Looking for a reliable abrasive supplier?
faq.moq.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.moq.a: MOQ comes back with the offer, alongside availability and terms.
faq.oem.q: Do you support OEM and private label?
faq.oem.a: Yes. Logo, labels, custom sizes and packing are checked for feasibility, then confirmed with your offer.
faq.sizes.q: Which sizes and grits do you supply?
faq.sizes.a: Belts in documented sizes from 533 × 75 to 2200 × 1330 mm (grits 40–800); discs 3–6 inch (grits 60–5000). Custom requirements are reviewed with our team.
faq.samples.q: Can I get a sample first?
faq.samples.a: Yes. Request a sample, and our sales team will confirm availability, charges and shipping arrangements.
faq.lead.a: Lead time depends on specification and quantity, and is confirmed in your quotation.
faq.packaging.a: Pack quantities, labels, carton marks and private-label artwork are confirmed with the quotation.
faq.payment.q: Which payment terms do you offer?
faq.payment.a: Payment terms are part of the confirmed quotation and commercial discussion.
